trend_annotations.label: Reported series demand
trend_annotations.summary: Named in a Q3 2026 market review among series with displayed product-page purchase counts above 100,000. This supports series-level interest, not audited units for this seller or variant, and does not measure weekly growth.
trend_annotations.period: Q3 2026 review; cumulative count period not specified
trend_annotations.metric: Reported product-page purchase-count threshold; not verified sold units
trend_annotations.scope: Series-level reporting; do not transfer to accessories or other product forms

trend_annotations.label: Reported launch interest
trend_annotations.summary: A reporter at the October 1 Shanghai launch described crowds at the cake pop-up where A Piece of Cake debuted. The separable cake-slice format and gift packaging are product features; the report does not establish sell-through or national growth.
trend_annotations.metric: Observed launch attendance; no sold-unit disclosure
trend_annotations.scope: Local launch event, not nationwide popularity

brand_context.title: YOYO IP growth — not a result for every product
brand_context.summary: MINISO reports more than RMB1 billion in global YOYO gross merchandise value in the first nine months of 2026. This is a company-reported global IP-level figure, not China-only revenue, audited unit sales or evidence that every YOYO series is trending.
